C1423.title: Horizen (ZenCash) Suffers 51% Attack with Over $500K in Losses
C1423.summary: On June 2, 2018, ZenCash, later renamed Horizen, suffered a 51 percent attack. After gaining majority control of the network's hash power, the attacker double-spent about 23,000 ZEN, worth approximately $550,000 at the time. After detecting the activity, the team warned exchanges and mining pools and recommended increasing the block-confirmation requirement for ZEN deposits.
